component.name: Disk Usage Analyzer (Baobab)
component.summary: Cockpit plugin for visualizing disk space utilization with rings charts, treemaps, and tree views

description.p: A Cockpit module inspired by GNOME Baobab (Disk Usage Analyzer) that scans local filesystems and directories and visualizes disk space usage using interactive concentric rings charts, treemaps, and expandable directory trees.
